bootstrap.unit: whole adjacent B/U pair, not the five within-batch repetitions

limits: Single serial run and one operand; bootstrap does not establish between-session, between-input or universal stability. No dropped outliers or sample-based 5pct selection.
no_advantage_action: Stop large tests;no service or new candidate GPU execution
advantage_action: Report conditional Amdahl sensitivity;propose only one strict-legacy candidate,do not execute it or service automatically
